comment: files.c fopen_wizkit_file() with WIZKIT=.NETHACKRC on the judge's case-insensitive APFS volume: access() in the playground fails with ENOENT ("Access to .NETHACKRC denied (2)."), then fopen("$HOME/.NETHACKRC") opens the config file the harness wrote as .nethackrc, so read_wizkit() wishes for its item lines: an elven mithril-coat and two potions of gain level. On Linux the second fopen() fails too and no item is made, so this recording must come from macOS (scripts/playground-case.test.mjs). Seed, date, elven Priest and items chosen independently.

segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Upcase,role:Priest,race:elf,gender:female,align:chaotic,playmode:debug,!legacy,!tutorial,!splash_screen,pettype:none,!autopickup
WIZKIT=.NETHACKRC
elven mithril-coat
2 potions of gain level
